programme.desc: Quem tem cão conhece o cenário: taças no chão, saco de ração à vista e um canto funcional, mas pouco bonito. Neste episódio, queremos criar uma zona de refeição para o cão que seja prática, organizada e integrada na decoração da cozinha.

programme.title: Aqui Há Sabor T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Fátima vai à casa do amigo de longa data José Figueiras para cozinhar um empadão. Entre memórias, muitas gargalhadas e histórias partilhadas, falam sobre o que sustenta três décadas de televisão: afeto, resiliência e uma alegria de viver constante.

programme.title: Aqui Há Sabor T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Fátima Lopes prepara bifes de peru panados com arroz de feijão, um prato cheio de memórias para Joana Cruz. Em cima da mesa, vários temas, incluindo a forma corajosa, bem-humorada e esperançosa com que Joana enfrentou o cancro.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T3 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Marlene Vieira mergulha nos sabores mais rústicos e reconfortantes da cozinha portuguesa, com duas receitas que evocam campo, família e comida feita com presença. A refeição começa com uma Sopa de Tomate, uma receita simples, com raízes no Ribatejo e no Alentejo, nascida da cozinha de aproveitamento e da valorização dos ingredientes da terra.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Neste episódio, Marlene Vieira cruza duas geografias e duas formas de conforto à mesa: o Algarve dos pescadores e o Alentejo dos pratos cozinhados devagar. A entrada é um Atum de Escabeche, receita ligada aos antigos métodos de conservação e pela memória da cozinha de pescadores.

programme.title: Gordon Great Escape T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Gordon viaja até à Tailândia, berço de uma das gastronomias que mais tem conquistado os britânicos. Ainda antes de deixar Banguecoque, um dos mais conceituados chefs televisivos do país inscreve-o num duelo culinário que será transmitido no seu programa no final da semana.

programme.title: Passport Properties T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Billy Nash mergulha a fundo e explora a Croácia, onde a história, a beleza e a ligação humana moldaram um dos destinos mais procurados do mundo quanto ao estilo de vida e a propriedade imobiliária.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy T1 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Mary aumenta os desejos com receitas que provam que não precisas de gastar uma fortuna para cozinhar pratos deliciosos.

programme.title: Renovation Resort T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Scott e Bryan agitam as águas na doca, com as equipas a criarem o seu melhor destaque, no desafio da sala principal e da entrada. Criar a melhor primeira impressão é crucial; irá uma sala lúdica agradar ao júri, ou apreciará um espaço mais virado para os livros?.

programme.title: Renovation Resort T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Scott e Bryan trabalham em conjunto na margem, enquanto as equipas se dirigem para o salão, no terceiro desafio. Vão precisar de criatividade e mestria para conquistar a Construção Extra surpresa.

programme.title: Pastelaria Para Todos T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Em Pastelaria para Todos, aprenderá a realizar uma multiplicidade de sobremesas elaboradas por Carlos Fernandes. Desde os petiscos mais doces e tradicionais. O jovem pasteleiro ensina a dominar uma infinidade de técnicas para que todos possam desfrutar das iguarias de pastelaria em casa.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 40
programme.desc: Stephanie tem um mês para converter o antigo estábulo num estúdio para o lançamento dos seus fins de semana de arte. No entanto, a discordância com a mãe Isobel quanto ao design pode fazer com que as renovações demorem mais do que o previsto.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 41
programme.desc: Neste episódio, colocar cabos elétricos no castelo de Dick e Angel é uma complicação. Conhecemos os novos proprietários, Donna e Paul, que se mudam para a sua nova casa no oeste de França, mas estão com dificuldade em aprender a língua.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Mary acalma seus nervos para um encontro servindo quatro receitas que certamente impressionarão o seu convidado especial.

programme.title: Gordon Great Escape T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Os vietnamitas são verdadeiros apaixonados pela gastronomia e não desperdiçam nada: se se mexe, vai para a mesa. Ao longo da sua viagem, Gordon fica impressionado com a lendária restauradora local, Mrs. Duck, uma verdadeira mestre da cozinha de aproveitamento integral.

programme.title: Cozinhamos Contigo T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: No episódio de hoje, a chef Lúcia Ribeiro, irá preparar a receita de “Chanfana” proposta pelo Mercado de Alvalade em Lisboa e, depois, irá cozinhar “Tarte de cenoura”, uma receita que nos chega do Mercado da Vila de Cascais.

programme.title: Toma Lá, Dá Cá T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Querem festa? Então estão no sítio certo. A Benedita Pereira irá ter uma formação de DJ e irá apresentar-se como a nova revelação, a DJ Nita. Assistam à festa, é imperdível.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Durante a demolição, Bryan e Sarah ficam a saber mais sobre a propriedade.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Bryan e Sarah vão à piscina do resort.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Chega o momento decisivo para Jonathan e Michael: enfrentam os seus investidores, que irão decidir se devem continuar a gerir a mansão. O negócio mal cobre os custos, e a mais recente ideia de Jonathan e Michael - manter cabras - não é bem recebida. Serão despedidos?.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Conhecemos a britânica Mandy e o seu sócio americano Steve, na sua deslumbrante mansão situada à beira de uma falésia na região da Dordonha, no sul de França.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Os aperitivos práticos da Mary elevam as receitas clássicas, mantendo-as simples. Ela melhora o anel de camarão normal com o seu cocktail de camarão grelhado e o seu prato de festa inclui uma coroa de rolos de salsicha e popovers de tábua de charcutaria.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood conhece a família Chretien que procura o cachorrinho ideal para criar uma ligação com o seu filho tímido, o Julian. Visitam o cockapoo, o labradoodle e o shichon. Cada membro da família tem o seu preferido, mas o Julian surpreende os seus pais com a sua decisão.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood conhece Inji, uma mãe solteira que procura um cachorrinho para realizar o sonho da sua filha Yasmine. Visitam o Yorkshire terrier, o papillon e o bichon maltês, mas quando Yasmine gosta de todos, a decisão de Inji torna-se difícil.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood conhece as irmãs Boccanfuso que procuram um cachorrinho para tomar conta delas na escola. Visitam o West Highland terrier, o Wheaton terrier e o Airedale terrier, mas quando cada uma das irmãs gosta de um cão diferente, as coisas complicam-se.

programme.title: Mudanças Na Casa De Família - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Cheryl junta Samantha Pynn a Kate Campbell e Dave Coleman para restaurar a casa de uma família que cedeu o seu espaço para reabilitar animais feridos.

programme.title: Mudanças Na Casa De Família - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Cheryl Hickey, juntamente com Mia Parres, Dave Kenney e Joey Fletcher, melhoram a casa de uma família cujas vidas mudaram para sempre após um acidente devastador.

programme.title: Mudanças Na Casa De Família - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Cheryl chama Brian McCourt e Tiffany Pratt para fazer uma revisão ao lar de Kate, a derradeira prestadora de cuidados, que continua a dar quando ela própria pouco tem.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Com os primeiros hóspedes da época prestes a chegar, a piscina continua a ser um pesadelo para Mandy e Steve. À medida que tentam terminá-la a tempo, surgem tempestades e novos atrasos fazem com que pareça que nunca conseguirão deixar a mansão pronta a tempo.

programme.title: Feito Para Durar T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Há elementos indispensáveis numa casa que nem sempre queremos ver e a caixa de areia do gato é um deles.

programme.title: Feito Para Durar T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Neste episódio, temos um desafio especial: criar um espaço de estudo confortável, bonito e inspirador para uma criança, sem comprar tudo novo.

programme.title: Renovation Resort T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Natalie Preddie é uma escritora de viagens e lifestyle premiada, apresentadora e personalidade da rádio. Escreve sobre as suas aventuras globais, que já a levaram a mais de 35 países e a tudo desde pousadas de juventude a estâncias de luxo, sempre com a família a reboque!.

programme.title: Renovation Resort T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Com o interior concluído, Scott e Bryan mandam as equipas para o exterior, desafiando-as a transformar os espaços ao ar livre. Rotem e Troy aquecem o ambiente, Jena e Sean contra-atacam com peças feitas à medida.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Marlene Vieira apresenta a nova temporada de Cozinha de Chef, dedicada à comida de tacho, prática, reconfortante e cheia de memória.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T3 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Neste episódio, Marlene Vieira regressa aos sabores mais reconhecíveis da cozinha portuguesa, com duas receitas simples, familiares e cheias de conforto.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos T3 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: John chega a Portsmouth, New Hampshire, mesmo a tempo para um taquito como nunca trincaram antes, recheado com cabeça de porco estufada. John parte para a Costa Ocidental para conhecer o cozinheiro de St. John’s, Nova Terra, que prepara um arroz frito de fazer crescer água na boca com a receita do seu avô, um dos primeiros chineses imigrantes na Nova Terra.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos T3 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: John parte até Courtenay, Colúmbia Britânica, para mergulhar no marisco espetacular disponível e dar uma colherada na sua típica sopa de marisco. Em Boston, Massachussets, John vai até um brunch onde come umas tostas de abacate com um toque mexicano na forma de tostada dourada e estaladiça. Em Toronto, Ontário, John presta homenagem a um pioneiro da cozinha toscana e prova um ragù de javali que o deixa profundamente apaixonado.

programme.title: Cozinhamos Contigo T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: No episódio de hoje, a chef Lúcia Ribeiro, irá preparar a receita de “Carapaus alimados” proposta pelo Mercado de Olhão e, depois, irá cozinhar “Arroz de cabidela”, uma receita que nos chega do Mercado de São João da Madeira.

programme.title: Cozinhamos Contigo T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: No episódio de hoje, a chef Lúcia Ribeiro, irá preparar a receita de “Chanfana” proposta pelo Mercado de Alvalade em Lisboa e, depois, irá cozinhar “Tarte de cenoura”, uma receita que nos chega do Mercado da Vila de Cascais.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Os aperitivos práticos da Mary elevam as receitas clássicas, mantendo-as simples. Ela melhora o anel de camarão normal com o seu cocktail de camarão grelhado e o seu prato de festa inclui uma coroa de rolos de salsicha e popovers de tábua de charcutaria.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A Mary preocupa-se em cozinhar de forma mais inteligente, não mais difícil, e partilha atalhos de supermercado fáceis para poupar tempo e stress na cozinha aos espectadores.

programme.title: Aqui Há Sabor T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Em casa de Bárbara Guimarães, Fátima cozinha uma deliciosa feijoada e conversa com a apresentadora sobre o que fica após os grandes desafios da vida: a busca de sentido, a coragem de recomeçar e a força serena que alimenta a resiliência.

programme.title: Aqui Há Sabor T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Fátima Lopes cozinha caldeirada para Marlene Vieira — uma prova de fogo! A renomeada Chef revela como venceu num meio ainda masculino, graças ao trabalho e ao talento. Uma conversa sobre a força e a identidade de uma mulher que não teme liderar.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Marlene Vieira apresenta a nova temporada de Cozinha de Chef, dedicada à comida de tacho, prática, reconfortante e cheia de memória.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T3 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Neste episódio, Marlene Vieira regressa aos sabores mais reconhecíveis da cozinha portuguesa, com duas receitas simples, familiares e cheias de conforto.

programme.title: Gordon Great Escape T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: No último episódio, Gordon dirige-se para sul, até às costas de Querala, em busca do melhor caril de marisco. Em Tamil Nadu, chega a uma zona sem carne e enfrenta o seu maior pesadelo culinário: viver num “ashram”, onde a única comida na ementa é vegetariana.

programme.title: Gordon Great Escape T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Os vietnamitas são verdadeiros apaixonados pela gastronomia e não desperdiçam nada: se se mexe, vai para a mesa. Ao longo da sua viagem, Gordon fica impressionado com a lendária restauradora local, Mrs. Duck, uma verdadeira mestre da cozinha de aproveitamento integral.

programme.title: Passport Properties T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Marraquexe, Marrocos, revela-se como um sonho sensorial - uma viagem através das cores, do artesanato e da ligação humana. Billy Nash hospeda-se num deslumbrante riad no coração da Medina, é guiado pelos habitantes locais por ruelas estreitas repletas de artesãos que fazem candeeiros, móveis e azulejos.

programme.title: Passport Properties T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Provença celebra a beleza, o sabor e o estilo de vida que continuam a atrair compradores de propriedades do mundo inteiro. Tornando da cidade medieval de Uzès a sua base, Billy Nash instala-se numa casa da cidade clássica da Provença e vive como um local.

programme.title: Personaliza A Tua Casa T1 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: No trabalho dos artesãos mais criativos Sofia Pereira encontra a inspiração para em cada episódio nos mostrar 3 propostas decorativas. Neste episódio – Lâmpadas.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T4 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Os filhos dos Baeumler estão a crescer rapidamente. Bryan e Sarah terminam os quartos dos rapazes e concentram-se num espaço especial para futuras noites de encontro.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T4 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Os Baeumler dão as boas-vindas aos visitantes da Florida durante as obras. A cozinha e a suite do quarto principal ganham forma.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 37
programme.desc: Treze anos depois de se mudarem para o castelo, Stephanie começa o trabalho de renovação da quinta e última suíte de BAndB, e visita Angel para alguma inspiração criativa.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 38
programme.desc: Com a quadra natalícia a aproximar-se rapidamente, Stephanie recruta o amigo próximo da família, Gerry, e a mãe, Isobel, para terminar o quarto de BAndB a tempo.

programme.title: O Último Viking

programme.title: Plano De Fuga 3

programme.title: Ratazana Assassina

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: No seu aniversário, Tyler e mais quatro amigos são levados pela namorada dele para um local desconhecido onde são trancados em quartos, dos quais só saem resolvendo vários quebra-cabeças. Só quando o jogo se torna perigoso é que todos eles percebem que algo está muito errado.

programme.title: Devota Com Pouca Sorte
programme.desc: Carmen Ruano dedicou toda a sua vida à confraria de Nossa Senhora de Santa Cruz da Caridade e da Esperança. Agora que o presidente da confraria se vai reformar, surge a oportunidade perfeita para tomar as rédeas e mostrar o seu valor. Mas nem tudo corre de feição...

programme.title: Dalida
programme.desc: Desde o seu nascimento em 1933 no Cairo, ao seu primeiro concerto em 1956 no Olympia em Paris até à sua trágica morte em 1987, Dalida foi uma diva do cinema e da música, que aqui se revela num retrato tocante da mulher por trás da estrela.

programme.title: O Amigo De Sempre
programme.desc: A história verídica e inspiradora de Matt e Nicole Teague e das suas filhas, quando a mãe é diagnosticada com cancro terminal. À medida que as responsabilidades de Matt como cuidador e pai se tornam cada vez mais esgotantes, Dane, o melhor amigo do casal, põe a sua vida em espera para os ajudar.

programme.title: Prisão 77
programme.desc: Em 1977, na transição para a democracia em Espanha, na prisão Modelo de Barcelona, um jovem contabilista aprisionado por um desfalque, junta-se a um grupo de prisioneiros que exigem uma amnistia geral ao mesmo tempo que procura uma forma de se evadir da prisão.

programme.title: Derradeira Viagem
programme.desc: Trinta anos depois de servirem juntos no Vietname, um antigo enfermeiro da Marinha, Doc Larry Shepherd, reúne-se com dois velhos amigos e antigos fuzileiros, Sal Nealon e o agora Reverendo Richard Mueller, para juntos enterrarem o seu filho, um jovem fuzileiro naval morto na guerra do Iraque.

programme.title: Academia De Polícia 2 A Primeira Missão
programme.desc: Os cadetes da Academia de Polícia já se tornaram agentes e é-lhes atribuída a pior esquadra da cidade, onde terão de ajudar o Capitão Pete Lassard a enfrentar o gangue do desvairado Zed.

programme.title: Novos Amigos Improváveis
programme.desc: Phillip é um homem rico e tetraplégico e Dell é um desempregado com cadastro criminal que é contratado para o ajudar. Apesar da relação inicial tensa, os dois acabam por forjar uma inesperada amizade, que mudará a via de ambos.

programme.title: Cidade Dividida
programme.desc: Na cidade de Nova Iorque, Billy Taggart, um ex-polícia caído em desgraça trabalha como investigador particular e é contratado pelo presidente da câmara de Nova Iorque, a quem deve um enorme favor, para espiar a sua mulher.

programme.title: Tango E Cash
programme.desc: Dois polícias de Los Angeles, o aprumado Ray Tango e o desalinhado Gabriel Cash, caem numa cilada do seu implacável arqui-inimigo e são colocados atrás das grades. Agora, vão ter de deixar para trás as suas diferenças e trabalharem juntos para poderem sobreviver e provar a sua inocência.

programme.title: Força Em Alerta 2
programme.desc: Casey Ryback parte de férias com a sobrinha num comboio do Colorado a Los Angeles, só que, logo no início da viagem, um grupo de terroristas invade o veiculo para usá-lo como quartel general na captura de um satélite altamente secreto e extraordinariamente destrutivo.

programme.title: Bunker Game
programme.desc: Após vários acidentes misteriosos, um jogo de interpretação de papéis ao vivo é interrompido e os jogadores abandonam o local. Enquanto isso, o pessoal permanece para trás para investigar o desaparecimento do mentor do jogo.

programme.title: A Crueldade De Peter
programme.desc: No início do século XX, Peter, o filho de 13 anos de uma rica família inglesa, é cruel com as crianças, os animais e os criados. Uma noite, em retaliação pela sua crueldade, é emboscado, atirado para um caixão enterrado no cemitério e esquecido. Até que um século depois ele é reencontrado

programme.title: Toro
programme.desc: Dois irmãos reencontram-se ao fim de dois anos um deles tem estado preso, o outro roubou um perigoso recetador e agora estão ambos em fuga, juntamente com Diana, a filha menor do último, numa viagem pela Andaluzia violenta, mítica, agreste e selvagem.

programme.title: O Livro Das Soluções
programme.desc: Marc é um realizador de cinema que leva toda a sua equipa de produção para a pequena aldeia de Cévennes, onde a sua a criatividade gera milhões de ideias que o mergulham no caos total, o que o leva a escrever um guia de conselhos práticos, O Livro das Soluções

programme.title: Alvo Número 1
programme.desc: Em 1989, um jornalista canadiano investiga as circunstâncias em torno do encarceramento altamente suspeito de um viciado em heroína numa prisão tailandesa.

programme.title: O Filho
programme.desc: A vida atribulada de Peter, da sua nova companheira Beth e do bebé do casal vai tornar-se ainda mais complicada quando vai viver lá para casa o problemático filho de 17 anos que ele teve com a ex-mulher, para o qual gostaria de ser o pai atento e cuidador que ele próprio nunca teve.

programme.title: O Pai Tirano
programme.desc: Chico ama Tatão, que é cortejada por Artur. Por seu turno, Graça ama Chico mas não sabe que ele ama Tatão. Santana escreve uma peça para os Grandelinhas que servirá de guião à paixão de Chico e convencerá Tatão de que ele é um rico conde. Mas nada vai acontecer como previsto.

programme.title: Réplicas
programme.desc: William Foster é um neurocientista genial cuja mulher e os três filhos morrem num acidente de carro. Secretamente, ele vai tentar clonar os seus corpos criando réplicas, mas vai ter de fazer uma escolha radical ele só consegue trazer três dos seus quatro familiares de volta à vida.

programme.title: A Morte Fica-vos Tão Bem
programme.desc: Há 14 anos, Madeline seduziu Ernest, que estava noivo de Helen, e casou com ele. Agora ele está alcoólico e deprimido e junta-se à antiga namorada para matar Madeline. Só que ela tomou um elixir da juventude que lhe dá vida eterna, por isso matá-la não será suficiente.

programme.title: O Informador
programme.desc: Peter Koslow é um ex-soldado das Operações Especiais que é recrutado pelo FBI para se tornar informador e derrubar o maior senhor do crime de Nova Iorque. Quando a operação corre mal, ele fica preso entre a máfia, a polícia e o FBI e terá de escapar para salvar a sua família.

Quando uma arma ultrassecreta cai em mãos erradas, a agente da CIA Mason Mace Brown terá de unir forças com a sua rival Marie, com a antiga aliada do MI6 Khadijah e ainda com a hábil psicóloga colombiana Graciela, numa perigosa missão na qual terão de enfrentar a misteriosa Lin Mi Sheng.

programme.title: O Cobrador 2
programme.desc: French e Sue voltam a formar uma dupla de cobradores de dívidas, desta vez com a missão de ir a Las Vegas recuperar o dinheiro da proprietária de um casino, que afinal já foi amante de um deles, ao mesmo tempo que tentam sobreviver ao mafioso que os mandou matar para vingar a morte do irmão.

programme.title: Homefront - A Última Defesa
programme.desc: Um ex-agente do departamento de combate à droga muda-se com a filha para uma pequena cidade rural em busca de uma vida tranquila. Quando um conflito escolar expõe o seu passado, ele atrai a atenção de um perigoso traficante local que ameaça a sua família.

programme.title: A Vigilante
programme.desc: Sadie é uma mulher que foi abusada pelo marido e que dedica a vida a salvar outras vítimas de violência doméstica, ao mesmo tempo que tenta matar o seu agressor para se tornar verdadeiramente livre.

programme.title: O Enigma Da Rosa
programme.desc: Uma família vê a filha mais nova ser raptada a caminho da escola e recebe uma carta do raptor a pedir um encontro antes de libertá-la. Para surpresa de todos, em vez de dinheiro, o raptor quer a confissão do segredo de um dos membros da família.

programme.title: Europakonzert 2013 - Prague
programme.desc: Every year since 1991, the Berliner Philharmoniker has given concerts in a different European city on each May 1st. These concerts have become known as ‘Europakonzert’. Every guest city has its own special cultural importance. These concerts have served two purposes: to commemorate the anniversary of the orchestra’s founding on May 1st, 1882, and to celebrate the common heritage of the Old World.

programme.title: Antonio Manna: Il basso napolitano
programme.desc: Stefano Demicheli conducts the Ensemble Talenti Vulcanici and soloists Nicola Cianncio (bass) and Catherine Jones (cello) in a varied baroque music program, recorded at Chiesa di Santa Caterina da Seina in Naples, Italy.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828.

programme.title: Baroque choral music by Bach, Schütz et al.
programme.desc: Five-strong vocal ensemble amarcord is joined by an extra alto and two soprano voices for this unusual concert at Leipzig’s St. Thomas Church. As amarcordplus, the ensemble presents a program focused on the city of Leipzig, which includes sacred madrigals by Johann Hermann Schein, motets from Heinrich Schütz’s collection Geistliche Chor-Music, as well as two motets by the most famous Thomaskantor: Johann Sebastian Bach.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16. French pianist Pascal Amoyel features as the soloist. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. It is the composer’s only concerto. The work premiered on April 3, 1869 in Copenhagen, Denmark, with Edmund Neupert as the soloist, and was received enthusiastically.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Schumann, Sibelius a. o.
programme.desc: Baritone Arvid Fagerfjäll (Sweden, 1991) and pianist Hikaru Kanki (Japan, 1993) perform ‘Lust der Sturmnacht’ from Robert Schumann’s Kerner-Lieder, Op. 35; ‘Le diable dans la nuit’ from Henriëtte Bosmans’ Dix mélodies; Franz Schubert’s Totengräbers Heimweh, D.

programme.title: Chopin - Ballade No. 1, Op. 23
programme.desc: Roberto Giordano performs Chopin's Ballade No. 1, Op. 23. The sketches of the work date back to 1831 during Chopin's eight-month stay in Vienna. The first ballade was completed in 1835 after the composer moved to Paris.

programme.title: Bach - Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006)
programme.desc: Gidon Kremer’s return to J. S. Bach’s partitas is a major event. Kremer’s first recording of these works was released almost a quarter of a century ago. In this recording from 2006, Kremer once again takes on the greatest challenge for any violinist: Bach’s magnificent “Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin” (BWV 1001-1006), which Kremer himself calls the “Himalayas” of violin music.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 for chamber orchestra
programme.desc: As part of the ‘Da Camera’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, the Spanish Grupo Fundación Mutua Madrileña performs Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’, in an arrangement for chamber orchestra by conductor Francisco Alonso Serena. The slowly starting opening movement of the symphony depicts the awakening of nature in spring.

programme.title: Hans van Manen – Moving to Music
programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. His over 150 ballets all bear his distinct signature, featuring a great clarity in structure, refined simplicity and an aversion to decorative frills.

programme.title: Chopin - Fantaisie in F minor, Op. 49
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Frédéric Chopin’s Fantaisie in F minor, Op. 49. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 10
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love.

programme.title: Chamber music by Haydn, Tchaikovsky and others
programme.desc: This chamber music concert is part of ‘Preludio’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. The program opens with Joseph Haydn’s Concerto in D major for cello and orchestra, H VIIb: 2 (cello and piano reduction), performed by cellist Alejandro Gómez Pareja and pianist Miguel Ángel Ortega Chavaldas.

programme.title: Patmos – A musical documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world.

programme.title: Debussy - La Mer
programme.desc: Claude Debussy’s symphonic sketches for orchestra known collectively as ‘La Mer’ evoke a richly varied vision of the sea. The first part (‘De l’aube á midi sur la mer’) calls up a morning and afternoon at sea, the second (‘Jeux de vagues’) echoes the play of the waves, and the third and final part (‘Dialogue du vent et de la mer’) conjures the communing voices of wind and waves.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Bach - Goldberg Variations (BWV 988)
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church, where Bach spent most time of his career as 'Thomaskantor', the musical director of the Thomanerchor church choir. The Goldberg Variations consist of one aria and a set of 30 variations.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 25 And Symphony No. 35
programme.desc: Stefano Conticello leads the Orchestra of Teatro Comunale di Bologna in a Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart program. The concert opens with the Overture from Mozart’s popular opera “The Magic Flute”. This is followed by Piano Concerto No. 25 in C major, K. 503, with Maurizio Baglini as the featured soloist. Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 25 is just one of the twelve great piano concertos he composed during 1784 and 1786.

programme.title: Handel - Messiah, HWV 56
programme.desc: The Messiah (HWV 56) by Georg Frederich Handel, also known as “A New Sacred Oratorio”, tells the life and suffering of Christ: a story of passion, fire, and sacrifice. This is one of Handel's best-known works, which took only three weeks to compose this oratorio and its famous 'Hallelujah'. The work has immense popularity since its premiere in Dublin in 1742, and is often presented at Easter.

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw 2018
programme.desc: Musical critics from North America, Europe, and Russia praise Nalchik-born pianist Misha Fomin for his subtlety of touch and phrasing. He graduated cum laude from the Gnessin’s Russian Academy of Music, Moscow, where he studied with Lina Bulatova, a former student of professor Helen Gnessina and legendary Heinrich Neuhaus, and later continued his musical studies at the Hochschule für Musik “Franz Liszt” in Weimar.

programme.title: Mozart - Clarinet Concerto in A major, K. 622
programme.desc: Conductor Marien van Staalen leads Amadeus Ensemble Rotterdam in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Clarinet Concerto in A major, K. 622. Henk de Graaf is the featured soloist. This performance was recorded at St. Nicholas Church in Vollenhove, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen leads Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13, ‘Winter Daydreams’, recorded at De Doelen in Rotterdam, the Netherlands in September 2022. Having completed a number of shorter orchestral works, Tchaikovsky embarked on a more ambitious project in March 1866: to write his first symphony.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 21
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performance of Frédéric Chopin's Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 21. Evgeny Kissin features as the soloist. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for “Best Classical Solo Vocal Album CRAZY GIRL CRAZY (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) 2018 and took home the Grammy for “Artist of the Year” in 2022. In autumn 2023 she made her long-awaited conducting debut with the Cleveland Orchestra. The programme featured an interesting mix of old and new with Haydn´s Symphony No.

programme.title: Johan de Meij - Echoes of San Marco And Fellini
programme.desc: This concert is the result of the collaboration between the Giuseppe Nicolini Conservatory of Piacenza and the Giuseppe Verdi of Milan as part of the project 'MIlanoPIACEnza ... suonare insieme.” On the program are works by the Dutch conductor and composer Johan de Meij. “Echoes of San Marco” is a tribute to the Venetian Renaissance composer Giovanni Gabrieli (1555-1612).

programme.title: Mahler - The Song of Lamentation
programme.desc: Mexican conductor José Areán leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería and four vocal soloists in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s cantata ‘The Song of Lamentation’ (Das klagende Lied). Among the soloists are soprano Sally Dibblee, mezzo-soprano Marjorie Elinor Dix, tenor Arturo Chacón, and bass Stephen West.

programme.title: Heavenly Voices - The legacy of Farinelli
programme.desc: The documentary 'Heavenly Voices – The Legacy of Farinelli' (2012) tells us the story of the castrato in music – male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range, a cruel practice that was in place mainly in the 17th and 18th centuries.

programme.title: Verdi - Rigoletto
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s tragic opera Rigoletto (1851). In 1850, Teatro La Fenice commissioned Verdi to compose a new opera. Verdi proposed Victor Hugo’s controversial play Le Roi s'amuse to his librettist Francesco Maria Piave.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies
programme.desc: Richard Danielpour (*1956) is one of the most beloved American composers of his generation due to his frequent referencing of and connection with the past, being inspired by American icons such as Aaron Copland, Samuel Barber and Leonard Bernstein. His lush musical language is often infused with swingy jazz rhythms just as is the music of Copland and Bernstein.

programme.title: Haydn - Symphony No. 45 'Farewell'
programme.desc: Under the direction of Conrad van Alphen, the Sinfonia Rotterdam Orchestra performs Haydn's Symphony No. 45 at the Nieuwe Kerk (New Church) in The Hague. This piece is nicknamed 'Farewell' because of a funny anecdote. Haydn and his musicians stayed every year from May to October at the magnificent Esterháazy Palace, at the request of Prince Nicholas.

programme.title: J. S. Bach: Mass in B minor, BWV 232
programme.desc: In this concert, Herbert Blomstedt conducts the Gewandhaus Orchestra and Kammerchor for the last time as the Gewandhaus Music Director at the Leipzig Bachfest 2005. After seven successful years in Leipzig, the maestro performs J. S. Bach's Mass in B minor (BWV 232), one of the greatest works of church music ever written. Soloists are Ruth Ziesak (soprano), Anna Larsson (alto), Christoph Genz (tenor), and Dietrich Henschel (bass).

programme.title: Ueda - Someone Out There is Praying for Peace I
programme.desc: Italian conductor Andrea Vitello leads his Ensemble BIOS in a performance of ‘Someone Out There is Praying for Peace (Let Us Not Be the Reason), I’, by contemporary Canadian composer Rita Ueda. This piece is written for strings and tar, a traditional plucked string instrument of Persian music, played here by Saeed Mirzazadeh. Ensemble BIOS specializes in 20th and 21st century music.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: The Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester was founded in 1986 at the initiative of Claudio Abbado and has since become the world’s best youth orchestra. Named after the great composer, the programme is marked by the special relationship between the maestro and the young orchestra, as well as their special relationship to Gustav Mahler.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 22
programme.desc: Pianist Mikhail Pletnev is accompanied by the Russian National Orchestra led by Kirill Karabits in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns's Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 22. At its premiere in 1868, the orchestra was led by Anton Rubinstein, with the composer himself at the piano. The current concert was recorded at the Moscow Philharmonic Society and opens with a performance of Sergei Prokofiev's symphonic picture 'Dreams'.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 1
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7.

programme.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen And Mozart's Requiem
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner, and Klaus Badelt.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22. The composer completed the work in 1838. Of Schumann’s three piano sonatas, Piano Sonata No. 2 is performed and recorded most frequently.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Le sacre du printemps
programme.desc: Maestro Bernard Haitink leads the Berliner Philharmoniker in a performance of Igor Stravinsky's Le sacre du printemps (‘The Rite of Spring’). Stravinksy composed the ballet’s score in 1913 for Sergei Diaghilev's itinerant ballet company Ballets Russes. The work’s sensational première at the Théâtre des Champs-Élysées in Paris caused a riot in the audience in response to the avant-garde nature of the music and choreography.

programme.title: First Snow
programme.desc: One of the first Christmas carols ever written is Perotin the Great’s Salvatoris Hodie. This brilliant 12th century composition, one of the first works ever written for four voices, opens First Snow: the atmospheric Christmas concert by the Brussels Philharmonic.

programme.title: Haydn - Symphony No. 94, Hob. I:94
programme.desc: Joseph Haydn (1732-1809): Symphony No. 94 in G major 'Surprise'. Berliner Philharmoniker; conductor: Mariss Jansons. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991. The musicians commemorate the anniversary of the orchestra's founding on May 1st, 1882, playing in different European cities. This concert was recorded in the church 'Hagia Eirene' in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala – Awards Night
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir take you on a musical journey through the greatest Oscar-winning films, from timeless classics like Casablanca to monumental masterpieces like The Godfather and iconic blockbusters like Forrest Gump —epic movies with music that deserves its very own place in film history.

programme.title: Galaxymphony Strikes Back
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music.

programme.title: J. S. Bach - Chamber music
programme.desc: Philippe Herreweghe conducts his Collegium Vocale Gent in this chamber music program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach. On the program are Bach’s Orchestral Suite No. 4 in D major, BWV 1069; Gott der Herr ist Sonn und Schild, BWV 79; and Missa brevis in G major, BWV 236. The soloists are soprano Dorothee Mields, tenor Thomas Hobbs, countertenor Alex Potter, and bass Peter Kooij.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel?
programme.desc: One of the world’s most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel’s Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard’s death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard’s nurse and her husband.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

Aqui a feira não é só comércio — é mar e monte, fé e sustento, é história a acontecer à sombra dos toldos e ao som do pregão. Aqui, tudo tem cor: os sapatos as vozes, as saias das mulheres que vendem com orgulho e graça. As vozes são firmes, as saias são sete.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 78
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo Do Destino - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 60
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 75
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Meu Campeão - Ep. 19
programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Meu Campeão - Ep. 20
programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Buddy Rich and his Big Band at North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: Buddy Rich: Live in '78 highlights the relentless power and unparalleled artistry of the man who was known as ‘The World’s Greatest Drummer.’ This concert, taped in Holland in 1978, showcases one of the tightest big bands in history, featuring acclaimed saxophonist Steve Marcus and other members of Buddy’s ‘Killer Force,’ the group he would later call ‘the best band I ever had.

programme.title: Jazz Open Stuttgart: Blue Note All Stars
programme.desc: Playing together for the first time, this concert features the 'young lions' of the late 1990s, the cream of contemporary jazz musicians. As a team of individualists, they mix contemporary and traditional jazz in a whole new way, playing well-known standards as well as their own compositions.

programme.title: Invisible World - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Episode 6: Herbie Hancock - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American keyboard player and bandleader Herbie Hancock (1940) achieved success as an incisive, harmonically provocative jazz pianist in the 1960s, then went on to gain wide popularity as a leader of electric jazz-rock groups. One of these, Hancock’s band The Headhunters, ushered in a new era of jazz that appealed to a far wider audience, making jazz listeners out of rhythm and blues fans, and vice versa.

programme.title: James Brown - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1981, legendary American singer James Brown gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: The Tällberg Foundation: 'Jazz for the Planet'
programme.desc: On October 19, 2021, John Patitucci (bass), Marco Pignataro (sax and musical director), and Joe Lovano (sax) showcased inspirational new originals at GBH's Fraser Performance Studio in Boston, MA, accompanied by Terri Lyne Carrington (drums), Nadia Washington (vocals), Chico Pinheiro (guitar), and Anastassiya Petrova (piano).

programme.title: View From The Outside
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Duke Ellington Orchestra - Het Concertgebouw
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Betty Carter/Jazzmeia Horn, Please Do Something
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: Keith Jarrett - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Portrait of Roy Ayers
programme.desc: ‘The legend of the groove’ is a series of documentaries devoted to the musicians who were most influential on contemporary hip hop, soul, rhythm 'n' blues, and on the course of history. Between the late 1950s and now, these musicians radically changed music. Although sometimes hardly in the public eye, they have all been major sources of inspiration for today's major artists: Prince, Erykah Badu, Janis Joplin and Jimi Hendrix.

programme.title: Herbie Hancock - Sly
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan - Maria
programme.desc: Arguably the greatest lady vocalists of all time are featured in this superb compilation. These historic recordings from the 1950s and 1960s offer a unique overview of different approaches to jazz singing that helped define the genre. Watch Billie Holiday’s performance of “God Bless The Child” closely and learn what made her such an influential jazz and pop singer.

programme.title: Woody Herman's Swinging Herd live in England 1964
programme.desc: Woody Herman: Live in '64 features a blistering one-hour concert from 1964 showcasing one of the very hottest line-ups of the 'Swinging Herd,' including trumpeter Bill Chase, trombonist Phil Wilson, and the amazing saxophonist Sal Nistico on the front line, as well as drummer Jake Hanna, bassist Chuck Andrus, and pianist-arranger Nat Pierce in the rhythm section.

programme.title: Three Cohens
programme.desc: They are three siblings, born in Israel, passed through New York, each leading brilliant careers. The youngest, Avishai, has established himself as one of the most original trumpet players of the moment, author of highly acclaimed albums on the ECM label. The second youngest, Anat, saxophonist and clarinetist, in love with Brazilian music and Benny Goodman, is one of the great 'jazzwomen' of today.

programme.title: Smith, Adderley, Brubeck, Mingus - Newport Jazz F.
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Jazz de Matosinhos and Sinfónica do Porto: Layas
programme.desc: 30 minutes of... Orquestra Jazz de Matosinhos and Orquestra Sinfónica do Porto Casa da Música conducted by Dirk Brossé. Casa da Música is a performance hall located in Porto, in northern Portugal. Brossé, born in Ghent, Belgium in 1960, is a versatile composer and a respected conductor on the international music scene. Pianist Jason Moran and cellist J.A. Pereira de Sousa accompany both sets.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Zara McFlaren
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Fats Domino - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. American singer and pianist Fats Domino gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1980.

programme.title: Hamilton e Laginha - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The series Da Pá Virada sessions presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is the duo of Hamilton and Laginha.

programme.title: Joe Zawinul - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. In 1985, Viennese keyboardist Joe Zawinul was one of the artists appearing at this festival.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Nile Rodgers
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Burton And Ozone - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Mont Saint-Michel: Steve Grossman And Peter King
programme.desc: Every year, the Jazz en Baie festival takes place in the beautiful bay of Mont Saint-Michel. Today’s broadcast shows a special gathering between saxophone heavyweights Peter King and Steve Grossman. These experienced musicians’ trip to the bay amounts to much more than a social call. The quintet, which is rounded out by bass player Duylinh N'Guyen, drummer Stéphane Huchard and pianist Alain Jean-Marie, delivers an amazing show.

programme.title: The Jackson Singers
programme.desc: The American gospel group The Jackson Singers, founded by Bob Jackson in 1980, found a warm welcome in Europe, where they have toured for decades. Embraced for their powerful spirituals and gospel music, they have become a celebrated presence in churches, cathedrals, and jazz festivals across the continent.

programme.title: Marcus Miller: Thoughts on Miles
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited’ tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: VEIN Plays Ravel
programme.desc: A sound support with provocative combinations, a modern music laboratory, a vehicle of inspiration whose importance has been proven by many high-profile collaborations. Music lovers who appreciate jazz for its ability to provoke and continuously question the status quo certainly do not expect that such a standard set in its configuration finds itself completely detached from tradition.

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: Marion Williams Sings Spirituals
programme.desc: You can’t help but be carried away by the powerful voice Marion Williams, who, with backing from Tommy Brown (piano), Joe Washington (organ), Billy Tuliver (drums), and singers Barbara White and Ann Bolden, sings gospel songs and spirituals as if she has lived them a thousand times over. The repertoire includes such familiar tunes as “Peace in the Valley,” “We Shall Overcome,” and “Michael, Row the Boat Ashore.”.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: World-renowned American blues singer and guitarist Magic Slim performed an electrifying set at the French festival Jazz à Vienne 2012. With bandmates John McDonald (guitar And vocals), Andre Howard (bass), and Brian Jones (drums), the blues giant played a string of classic Chicago blues hits. Ever energetic, the veritable blues veteran put on a dynamic show for an enthusiastic audience in the atmospheric ancient Roman theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: Live in France: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: Jimmy Smith: Live in '69 boasts an incredible 90-minute concert from 1969 filmed in Paris. Working in his classic trio format with longtime guitarist Eddie McFadden and drummer Charlie Crosby, Jimmy shows why he is still the uncontested king of the jazz organ.

programme.title: Jacques Loussier in Leipzig: Play Bach and More
programme.desc: In 1959, Jacques Loussier hit upon the idea that was to make his international reputation, by combining his interest in jazz with his love of J.S. Bach. Only a pianist with such an exceptional classical technique and deft improvisatory skill could have nurtured such a vision. He founded the Play Bach Trio, which used Bach's compositions as the basis for jazz improvisation. The trio immediately caught the public imagination.

programme.title: Piano and Sax: Charlie Mariano And Wolfgang Dauner
programme.desc: Piano and saxophone - this is an individualistic jazz duo combination. But the melodiousness and maturity of Charlie Mariano's saxophone and the freshness and feistiness of Wolfgang Dauner's piano turn the meeting of these two jazz greats into a thrilling interplay.

programme.title: Mr. Phone Bone
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: John Lurie: A Lounge Lizard Alone
programme.desc: In 1978, John Lurie formed The Lounge Lizards jazz ensemble with his brother Evan; the pair played music together for 20 years. However, in this New Year's Eve performance, Lurie (saxophone) plays a legendary show with drummer Larry Wright. Lurie is a musician, actor, painter, and the driving force behind the Strange And Beautiful music label.

programme.title: Give It to Him
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: You Don't Know What Love Is
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Ray Charles and the Raelettes - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Come Twogether ft. Benjamin Herman
programme.desc: Instead of children’s songs, the sound of jazz standards was always present. They practiced intricate drum rhythms instead of Bach etudes: Simon Oslender and Jérôme Cardynaals have jazz running through their veins! Under the name ‘Twogether’ both youngsters celebrate a very unique and soulful style of funky blues-jazz. They create a sound that leaves even renowned jazz artists speechless.

programme.title: Song for my father
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: Festival international de jazz Adolphe Sax
programme.desc: On June 4, 1962, the first Festival International de Jazz ‘Adolphe Sax’ took place in the Belgian town of Dinant, where Adolphe Sax, the inventor of the saxophone, was born in 1814. Not surprisingly, most artists on the program are saxophonists. A Belgian quartet, consisting of tenor saxophonist Jacques Bailly, guitarist Willy Donni, drummer Bruno Castellucci, and bassist José Bedeur, opens the festival.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton Big Band - Kurhaus Scheveningen
programme.desc: The Kurhaus in Scheveningen is a grand hotel in the Netherlands renowned for attracting both royal and musical nobility. Doubling as a concert hall, it has been host to several heavy hitters, such as the Rolling Stones and Ike and Tina Turner. On August 2, 1983, American vibraphonist Lionel Hampton performed at the Kurhaus in Scheveningen.

programme.title: Four Pianists - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2012 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music.

programme.title: Dragon
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Duke Ellington live at the Concertgebouw Amsterdam
programme.desc: Duke Ellington: Live in '58 features the earliest-known filmed full-length concert by one of the 20th Century's greatest songwriters and bandleaders. Filmed at Amsterdam's famed Concertgebouw, this 80-minute concert features the 16-piece Duke Ellington Orchestra two years after their stunning performance at the 1956 Newport Jazz Festival, which Duke considered his second birth.

programme.title: La nuit des gitans
programme.desc: The Royal Conservatoire of Liège hosted a ‘Night of the Gypsies’ at the International Guitar Festival of Liège in 1995. At this occasion, the Raphaël Faÿs Trio and Quintet paid tribute to Romani-Belgian jazz guitarist Django Reinhardt.

programme.title: Django Memories
programme.desc: To celebrate the release of Django, the Parisian New Morning Club pays tribute to the legendary guitarist Django Reinhardt. The program showcases the magic of Reinhardt’s compositions, as well as the virtuosity of one of his most famous heirs: Stochelo Rosenberg. With unbridled passion and enthusiasm, Rosenberg interprets the music that marked French musical heritage: gypsy jazz.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner’s first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson’s and Art Farmer’s Jazztet.

programme.title: Troy 'Trombone Shorty' Andrews: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz phenomenon Trombone Shorty dishes out a mix of funk, jazz, hip-hop and soul at this concert at the French festival Jazz à Vienne. Playing with the energy of a rock star, Troy Andrews, a.k.a. ‘Trombone Shorty’, pays homage to jazz legends. With his hypnotic performance and boundless energy, Trombone Shorty puts up an unparalleled performance.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Carlinhos Brown
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Flying Home
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, American singer Ella Fitzgerald gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson.

programme.title: Solo Piano Summit
programme.desc: When renowned jazz pianists of the old and new school meet at a 'Solo Piano Summit,' audiences are treated to many an interesting musical surprise. The 'Solo Piano Summit' brings together a handful of top pianists with different musical backgrounds: Jacky Terrasson, Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap and Alex Wilson.

programme.title: Chick Corea Elektric Band - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Münchner Klaviersommer: Eliane Elias Trio
programme.desc: There’s no question about it: with a Grammy for Best Latin Jazz Album for her recording ‘Made In Brazil’, seven previous Grammy nominations, four ‘Gold Disc Awards’, and three ‘Best Vocal Album Awards’ in Japan, Eliane Elias has taken her place in the pantheon of music giants. In her projects, Elias wears many hats: she serves as producer, composer, lyricist, arranger, pianist, and vocalist.

programme.title: Liz McComb in Paris: Back to Blues
programme.desc: This film is a souvenir of an extraordinary concert. It reveals the true personality of Liz Mc Comb: more than a great gospel singer, she is a lover who dreams of sharing her generosity with us. Liz Mc Comb sings, among others, 'I'm Just a Poor Wayfaring Stranger' for all the immigrants in the world, followed by her famous 'Time Is Now'.

programme.title: Non Stop Travels: The Story of Michel Petrucciani
programme.desc: This film portrays Michel Petrucciani 's very unique outlook on life, his vitality, boisterous humor and marked comedian talent which triumphes over all physical restrictions. It also shows Michel Petrucciani performing, composing, selecting his very own piano, at a recording session with Stephane Grapelli, Roy Haynes and Georges Mraz, .... and much more.

programme.title: Ça Commence aujourd'hui
programme.desc: Tous les jours, Faustine BOLLAERT accueille sur le plateau de « Ca commence aujourd’hui » des hommes et des femmes qui viennent témoigner sur une période de leur vie, un drame, une épreuve, un cap à passer ou un changement, et qui font souvent écho à de grands sujets de société. Entourée d'experts : psychologues, psychiatres, avocats, gynécologue, Faustine aide les témoins et les téléspectateurs à mieux comprendre ce qu’ils ont vécu.

programme.title: Affaire Conclue
programme.desc: Julia Vignali accueillera et accompagnera les propriétaires d’objets lors de leur expertise par l’un de nos commissaires-priseurs. En accord avec l’estimation de l’expert, Julia Vignali remettra un Pass au propriétaire, précieux sésame pour se présenter en salle des ventes devant nos acheteurs. Le vendeur pourra espérer tirer le meilleur prix de son objet en le vendant aux enchères à une sélection d’acheteurs venus des 4 coins de la...

programme.title: Ho Chi Minh Ville entre Tradition et Modernité
programme.desc: Le Vietnam revient de loin, Hô Chi Minh ville s’est ouvert au monde extérieur. Tout y change très vite, dans une espèce d’impatience à vouloir rattraper le temps perdu. Ville aux multiples visages, l’ancienne Saigon mêle les cultes et les traditions ancestrales, avec un futur ultra moderne. Comme le Ying et le Yang, la ville ne divise pas, elle respecte, honore et unit les contraires en harmonie.

programme.title: Arnaques!
programme.desc: Assurances : des milliers de Français arnaqués C’est peut-être la plus vaste arnaque financière de ces dernières décennies. Prélèvements abusifs, ventes forcées, signatures falsifiées… la SFAM, spécialisée dans l’assurance de téléphones et ordinateurs, est accusée d’avoir piégé des milliers de clients. Préjudice estimé : 25 millions d’euros.

programme.title: Arnaques!
programme.desc: Construction de maison, rénovation et piscine : les équipes d’« Arnaques ! » ont remonté la piste de trois artisans malhonnêtes. Entrepreneur, influenceur, candidat TV : il les a ruinés Dans le Nord, la maison de famille de Mathieu et Cécile a résisté à plusieurs guerres mais pas à Monsieur D, un homme qui s’est fait passer pour un professionnel du bâtiment. Le couple pourrait en avoir pour 1 million d’euros pour reconstruire.

programme.title: Les Infaillibles
programme.desc: Alors qu’un gang de braqueurs sème le chaos à Paris et humilie la police depuis des mois, le ministre de l’Intérieur veut du sang neuf à la tête de l’enquête : Alia est marseillaise, explosive et ingérable, Hugo est parisien, major de promo et méticuleux. Bref, ils ont tout pour se détester. Une alliance forcée, pour le meilleur et pour le pire… et plus si affinités ?

programme.title: O Melhor Do Mundo Com Antoni Porowski T1 - Ep. 3

Enquanto jantam com a realeza e escalam os Alpes da Baviera, descobrem segredos dramáticos por detrás da decisão dos antepassados de James de emigrar.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T1 - Ep. 2

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: O fim do Inverno aproxima-se e a mudança da estação traz novas oportunidades, enquanto fecha a porta para outras. Sam ouviu de outros pescadores que alabote foi apanhado na área. Após meses a viver de comida congelada, ele está ansioso para apanhar algum peixe saboroso. Entretanto, a época das armadilhas está a chegar ao fim e isso significa que Gary vai perder um dos seus principais ganha pão.

Sem vários escudos, um gerado pelo nosso núcleo planetário único, outro pela nossa atmosfera e um terceiro pelos sistemas atmosféricos interligados, a vida na Terra nunca poderia acontecer..
